Name: SVE Alesia Seasonal Anime Potraits
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
When Working on my own anime mod-list for my Stardew playthrough I came across Alesia, a character without a modded portrait and immediately I went to nexus to rectify this, which is where I came across DawnWander's Anime rendition of Alesia and fell in love with their work. Only thing was there wasn't Seasonal Outfit compatibility with this excellent portrait so I took it upon myself to make these as I felt it deserved it! I'm by no means an artist so hopefully you can overlook my work if it's shoddy, just wanted to make something satisfactory to me and hope you'll enjoy it as well!

Deserved Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/133808923]DawnWander[/url] for the Base Portrait used, please check out their mod at:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17516]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19349[/url]
Thanks again for your support Dawn!

How to Install:
First install: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]
Next: Simply just replace the folder containing Alesia's Portrait's with my own! (If on vortex you must empty Alesia's folder on Seasonal Outfits - Slight Cuter Aesthetic for SVE out, DEPLOY, then put portraits in, REDEPLOY)

Downloads.Description: Take these files and move them into Seasonal Outfits for SVE's assets -> Potraits -> Alesia, replacing the portraits originally from there.
